reviewer: Independent GATE new seven-arm synthetic wrapper review
acceptance_scope: New delayed_research_comparison wrapper and its comparison-level benchmark-entry/carry gates only. The accepted ledger, delayed bridge, timing convention and frozen strategies were reused as unchanged dependencies, not reopened.

blocking_findings.classification: SHOWN source; REPRODUCED focused synthetic counterexample
blocking_findings.title: Resumed benchmark entry trusts an unbound ACCEPTED marker
blocking_findings.finding: Fresh calls derive entry evidence from actual initial-E buys and each control's intended symbols. Resume only checks comparison_entry.status=='ACCEPTED', then copies that record without validating its expected/entered/missing symbols, execution clock or correspondence to the carried trade ledger. A cash-arm entry record with an empty expected set therefore passes as proof for BTC hold and the two-asset mix. A malformed/cross-attached carry record can make failed benchmarks usable while all wallet/bridge states remain otherwise valid.

reproduction.setup: Synthetic A/B panel and zero-cost accounts; A is known ineligible. Run the initial three frames of the common period. BTC hold has no A buy, and the mix enters only B. Both entry records correctly report INCOMPLETE; all underlying ledger states remain valid diagnostic states.
reproduction.only_change: Deep-copy the cash state's comparison_entry into the hold_btc and declared_btc_eth_cash_mix states. No wallet, trade, pending order, rule, profile, recipe, historical input or clock is changed.

observed.only_change: copy accepted empty cash comparison_entry into failed hold and mix states

reproduction.expected: Reject the contradictory carry before simulation, or independently re-establish each named control's initial-E entry from its actual carried trades. A failed initial benchmark must never become COMPLETE/economic_result_usable because an unrelated empty-set marker was copied.
reproduction.boundary: This is an externally supplied inconsistent carry-metadata case, not a claim that an unmodified valid full/split run spontaneously fails. The wrapper explicitly accepts and validates caller carry state, so entry evidence must reconcile with the available trade ledger just as its new gate promises.
reproduction.impact: Uninvested cash can be relabeled as successful BTC hold, and a one-component position as the declared mix; top-level comparative economics becomes usable despite missing intended benchmark entries.

blocking_findings.required_closure: For resumed controls, recompute or reconcile entry evidence from the carried trades, intended control components and original E. Validate the entire record rather than its status string alone and refuse missing/contradictory proof before running any arm. Retain the original entry result without retrying or inventing fills. Add a copied-empty-cash-proof/contradictory-entry carry regression. This needs no cryptographic state framework or ledger replay.

positive_evidence.classification: SHOWN source and focused synthetic regressions
positive_evidence.subject: Fresh benchmark gate
positive_evidence.detail: Initial calls require positive nonterminal buys at E for every intended control component. Missing open, ineligibility, minimum/lot refusal and partial mix entry are distinguished from a mechanically COMPLETE cash ledger. Comparison status and NAV/profit fields become unknown while diagnostic wallets/costs remain available.

positive_evidence.classification: SHOWN source and focused synthetic regressions
positive_evidence.subject: Common clocks/capital and controls
positive_evidence.detail: Seven alternative accounts use caller-supplied common capital/costs/frames. The A-to-E hour is explicitly flat cash in equity; control buys occur at E and final marking at B, without a post-fill capital rebase or profit/capital summation. Fixed-unit controls emit one initial target and do not rebalance after price changes.

positive_evidence.classification: SHOWN source and focused synthetic regressions, subject to blocker
positive_evidence.subject: Partial periods and carry
positive_evidence.detail: Partial chunks suppress the entire top-level net-profit summary. Complete economics additionally requires all seven states at B and all arm statuses COMPLETE. Recipe binds universe/identities/mix/A/E/B; shared profile and bridge bindings retain capital/cost/history constraints. Ordinary full/split state/trade/equity equality, missing-state/clock/recipe/cost drift refusal and unmodified failed-entry carry refusal passed. These tests do not validate a cross-attached entry marker.

focused_probe.safeguards: Socket construction/create_connection/DNS and subprocess Popen/run refuse before wrapper imports. Only invented constant-price data and an in-memory HOLD signal stub were used, as in the wrapper unit fixtures. The control gate itself is real source code.

retained_limits: The confirmed blocker is in the new carry entry-proof gate, not a reopened accepted ledger/bridge/timing issue.
Arm-level results during partial periods remain diagnostics; the entire top-level comparison must be unusable until all required entries and B completeness are established.
Synthetic full-fill and explicit common venue/quote/no yield or FX conventions are modelling assumptions, not actual fill, entitlement, liquidity/capacity or settlement evidence.
The wrapper chooses no experiment capital/cost/horizon and computes no statistics or selection screen. A mechanically usable result is not economic PASS, profitability or run authorization.
No broad matrix, market data, live operation, full suite, historical strategy study or new infrastructure was used. No fix was implemented by the reviewer.

read_scope.dependency_scope: Accepted dependencies hash-bound only, plus the requested existing test slices. No prior ledger/bridge/design/runtime/SDK audit reopened.
read_scope.exact_bindings: All 10 declared binding inputs, the binding record itself and four other requested compatibility test files are in hashes.reviewed_inputs.
read_scope.focused_counterexample: One temporary script exercised only the new wrapper's failed-entry carry boundary; no broad parameter matrix or new framework.
